purpose: Expose recovery-only UI for retained pack publication, import reconciliation and finalization. Preserve close guards and do not restart an import during recovery.

initialFailures.reason: A test incorrectly rejected an AbsorbPointer ancestor with absorbing=false; changed to reject only actively absorbing ancestors.

The test assigned phase without preparedSummary, yielding a null check in _rememberImported; corrected the fixture to reach retained states through the real controller preparation and one initial apply.

assertions: Normal catalogue announces unavailable pack transfers at two sizes.
Publication reconciliation uses its actual UI action and performs no second export.
Import reconciliation and finalization use actual UI actions; the first reconcile failure keeps the close guard and the second succeeds without a second apply.
Recovery job uses the original operationId; the waiting state does not show a running spinner.
The test transport is instrumented; project and map fixture bytes remain unchanged.
limitations: The 7 isolated cases are included in the 35-test group.
The tests use the real controller and UI with an instrumented transport; they do not prove native archive recovery or an actual desktop session.
No native visual, G0 or full T01 acceptance.
